output.narrative: The child is actively engaging with stories and sharing ideas in the classroom. In July, the child named familiar characters and answered simple questions about picture books, and by August, used picture prompts to help recall and share a short account of a picnic with friends. During small-group activities in October, the child successfully retold the beginning and middle of a familiar story, and when provided with a guiding question, was able to explain the ending. Throughout the semester, the child has also shared personal ideas during group time, utilizing a little prompting to help express thoughts.
